labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: Requests new default number-and-unit highlighting behavior.

body:
Please raise this proposal in [Rich Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) first; new features need approval there before an issue. In the meantime, you can define a custom `RegexHighlighter` for number and unit pairs and pass it to `Console`; see [Custom Highlighters](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/highlighting.rst).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
